summary: Our project aims to develop a publicly accessible web platform that brings together sky images captured at different dates and times, enabling users to easily explore and compare changes in the sky over time. By collecting scattered visual data in one organized platform, the project makes it easier to observe variations in cloud formations, daylight, seasonal patterns, weather events, and atmospheric conditions. With its simple, user-friendly interface and open-access structure, the platform allows students, teachers, researchers, amateur sky watchers, and nature enthusiasts to explore sky images without registration or technical knowledge. Ultimately, our goal is to make sky observation more accessible, encourage scientific curiosity, and strengthen the connection between people, nature, and science.
details:
Project Details

1. Project Overview

Our project is a publicly accessible web platform designed to bring together sky images captured at different dates and times. It enables users to explore, observe, and compare changes in the sky through an organized visual interface. By collecting images from different sources in one place, the platform transforms scattered visual information into an accessible and meaningful experience.

2. The Problem We Address

The sky is constantly changing due to seasonal variations, weather conditions, cloud formations, daylight patterns, and atmospheric processes. Although numerous satellite images and sky observations are available online, they are often distributed across different platforms and databases. This makes it difficult for users to access, organize, and compare images from different time periods.

Our project addresses this challenge by providing a centralized platform where users can easily explore visual changes in the sky over time.

3. Our Proposed Solution

We aim to create a simple and interactive web application that allows users to:

  • Access sky images collected from different dates and time periods.
  • Explore visual changes in the sky through an organized gallery.
  • Compare images from different dates to identify visible differences.
  • Observe changes in cloud formations, atmospheric conditions, and daylight.
  • Navigate the platform easily without requiring registration or technical expertise.

4. Target Audience

The platform is designed for a wide range of users, including:

  • Students and teachers interested in science and astronomy.
  • Researchers and individuals interested in environmental observations.
  • Amateur sky watchers and photography enthusiasts.
  • Anyone curious about nature and changes in the atmosphere.

5. Innovation and Impact

The main strength of our project is its focus on accessibility and visual comparison. Instead of requiring users to navigate multiple data sources, our platform brings relevant sky images together in one place.

It also encourages visual learning, scientific curiosity, environmental awareness, and the exploration of time-dependent changes in nature.

6. Our Goals

Our primary goals are to:

  • Make sky observation accessible to everyone.
  • Bring visual information from different time periods together.
  • Encourage users to explore and compare environmental changes.
  • Support open access to scientific and visual information.
  • Strengthen the connection between technology, nature, and science.

7. Expected Outcomes

The expected outcome is a user-friendly web platform that makes exploring sky images easier, faster, and more engaging. By providing a shared visual space for observing the sky, our project aims to encourage people of all ages to discover the dynamic nature of our atmosphere and develop a greater interest in scientific observation.
